title: RoleReplyHeaders
description: The identity headers on every reply from a role route, including a 503: which engine build, model file and revision answered, or `none` for each when no engine did. Home's engineIdentity check reads these instead of probing a process.

x-maipai-engine.description: The engine host and build that answered (`local b10797`), or `none`.

x-maipai-model.description: The model file that answered, or `none`.

x-maipai-revision.description: The model's pinned revision or the engine build string, or `none`.
